crossRefs.note: the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread;
You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and…
even those who were counted of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.

translations.web: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.
translations.bsb: Additionally, make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
translations.asv: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of acacia wood, and overlay them with brass.
